label: Virginia Wing
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3.25 in (wings 3.25 in, as patch-new-york-wing); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

artwork.format: webp (lossy, with alpha) -> png via dwebp

ground_removed.colour: none: the ground was already clear

provenance: Unit emblem of Virginia Wing (MAR-VA-001), digital artwork sent by the owner, 2026-11-18, as the unit's official digital emblem. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (lossy, with alpha), 1424 x 1424 px, 8-bit RGBA after decoding; the file came with its ground already clear and a clean edge (no pale fringe: 2 and 16 band pixels lighter than both the surface and the outline on navy and on the OCP), so no pixel was changed; the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (1424 x 1424 px to 1321 x 1335 px); every pixel inside the emblem's outline is untouched; no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. Charter: MAR-VA-001 is the Virginia Wing headquarters in the builder's unit list (a wing's emblem carries the code of its headquarters); the Mid-Atlantic Region code MAR for Virginia units is confirmed by the wing's own news page, which lists its squadrons as MAR-VA-nnn.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the trim to the emblem's box.
